payload.campaign: uuid — the campaign whose live session's player view shows the window
payload.x: number — where the window's left edge goes, a fraction of the screen's width; one outside 0 to 1 is brought back to it
payload.y: number — where the window's top edge goes, a fraction of the screen's height; one outside 0 to 1 is brought back to it. The width and the media stay; a window that is not open is rejected under window-fields-together
